questions.question: Which is the verb of the word ‘false’
questions.explanation: 'False' (মিথ্যা) একটি Adjective। এর Verb form হলো 'Falsify' (মিথ্যা বা জাল করা, বিকৃত করা)। Falsehood হলো noun।

questions.question: Which is the adjective of the word ‘contempt’?
questions.explanation: 'Contempt' (ঘৃণা/অবজ্ঞা) একটি Noun। এর Adjective form হলো 'Contemptible' (ঘৃণ্য বা অবজ্ঞেয়)।

questions.question: কোনটি শুদ্ধ বানান?
questions.explanation: সঠিক বানান হলো 'Collaboration' (C-o-l-l-a-b-o-r-a-t-i-o-n), যার অর্থ যৌথ উদ্যোগ বা সহযোগিতা।

questions.question: “They elected him captain”. বাক্যের পরিবর্তিত voice form হচ্ছে ----

options.ক: He has been elected captain by them.
options.গ: He was elected captain by them.
options.ঘ: He is elected captain by them.

questions.explanation: Factitive object (Captain) যুক্ত Past Indefinite Active-এর Passive রূপ: 'He was elected captain by them.'

questions.question: “His behavior annoys me sometimes”. বাক্যের Passive form হচ্ছে ----

options.ক: Sometimes I am annoyed at his behavior.
options.খ: Sometimes I am annoyed to his behavior.
options.গ: I was annoyed sometimes at his behavior.
options.ঘ: I am annoyed sometimes at his behavior.

questions.explanation: 'Annoy'-এর পর কোনো আচরণ (behavior) থাকলে preposition হিসেবে 'at' বসে: 'Sometimes I am annoyed at his behavior.'

questions.question: Nasima said, “What a fine picture it is!” এর Indirect speech হচ্ছে ---

options.ক: Nasima said that it is a very fine picture.
options.খ: Nasima exclaimed that it was a very fine picture.
options.গ: Nasima exclaimed that it is a very fine picture.
options.ঘ: Nasima exclaimed that what a fine picture it was.

questions.explanation: Exclamatory বাক্যের Indirect Speech: 'Nasima exclaimed that it was a very fine picture.'

questions.question: “He asked me when the next letter would come”. বাক্যের direct speech হচ্ছে ---

options.ক: He said to me,”When would the next letter come?”
options.খ: He asked me,”When will the next letter come ?”
options.গ: He said to me,”When will the next letter come?”
options.ঘ: He said to me,”When the next letter will come?”

questions.explanation: Indirect speech-এর 'when the next letter would come' Direct speech-এ Future Indefinite 'When will the next letter come?' রূপ নেয়। তাই গ সঠিক।

questions.question: He is afflicted -----gout. বাক্যের শূন্যস্থানে সঠিক শব্দ বসবে ---
questions.explanation: কোনো রোগ বা বেদনায় পীড়িত বা জর্জরিত বোঝাতে 'afflicted with' বসে: 'He is afflicted with gout.'

questions.question: “Your conduct admits -----no excuse.” বাক্যের শূন্যস্থানে সঠিক শব্দ বসবে ---
questions.explanation: 'Admit of' একটি appropriate preposition, যার অর্থ কোনো কিছুর অবকাশ বা সুযোগ থাকা: 'Your conduct admits of no excuse.'

questions.question: ‘To see eye to eye with’ idiom- টির সঠিক অর্থ ----
questions.explanation: 'To see eye to eye with' idiom-টির অর্থ কারও সাথে সম্পূর্ণ একমত হওয়া (To agree fully with someone)।

questions.question: ‘All at once’ idiom- টির অর্থ হচ্ছে---
questions.explanation: 'All at once' idiom-টির অর্থ আকস্মিকভাবে বা হঠাৎ (Suddenly)।

questions.question: কোনটি শুদ্ধ বাক্য?

options.ক: I am not bad with tennis.
options.খ: He has assured me of safety.
options.গ: He parted with his friends in tears.
options.ঘ: The rich is not always happy.

questions.explanation: Comparative degree 'taller'-এর পর Subjective Pronoun 'I' বসে: 'Sohel is taller than I (am).' তাই ক সঠিক।

questions.question: কোন বাক্যটি শুদ্ধ?

options.খ: Everything hinges for what happens next.
options.গ: I have no aptitude to music.
options.ঘ: I concur with you on your decision.

questions.explanation: 'See' verb-এর পর Bare Infinitive (write) বসে: 'I saw him write something' (আমি তাকে কিছু লিখতে দেখেছিলাম)। কীতে ক সঠিক উত্তর দেওয়া হয়েছে।

questions.question: ‘Vacant’ শব্দের Synonym হচ্ছে –
questions.explanation: 'Vacant' শব্দের অর্থ শূন্য বা ফাঁকা। এর যথার্থ সমার্থক হলো 'Blank' (খালি)।
